title: NTA NEET UG Entrance Exam OMR Answer Sheet 2026 | Re Exam
vacancyDetails: Answer key related update for NEET UG 2026 – OMR Answer Sheet (Re-Exam)
selectionProcess: Written / CBT → Answer Key / Objections → Result
documentsRequired: Registration number / roll number; admit card for reference
howToApply:
1. Visit https://neet.nta.nic.in
2. Open Answer Key / Response Sheet section
3. Download NTA NEET UG Entrance Exam OMR Answer Sheet 2026 | Re Exam
4. Match answers with your response sheet
5. Raise objections within the official window if allowed
shortDescription: NTA NEET UG 2026 OMR Answer Sheet for re-exam candidates. Check on neet.nta.nic.in.
content:
National Testing Agency (NTA) has provided the NEET UG 2026 OMR Answer Sheet facility for candidates of the re-examination cycle as applicable.

Login with application number and password/DOB on the official NEET portal to view/download OMR responses and compare with the answer key.
